extracted.intended_audience: registrants (issuers), securities counsel, corporate accountants, and compliance officers preparing SEC registration statements and periodic reports
extracted.subtask_description: Detailed exhibit-by-exhibit requirements under Item 601 of Regulation S-K describing which documents must be filed as exhibits to registration statements and Exchange Act reports, how they must be presented, and exceptions/redaction and electronic filing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Underwriting agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Each underwriting contract or agreement with a principal underwriter pursuant to which the securities being registered are to be distributed; if the terms of such documents have not been determined, the proposed forms thereof.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such agreement may be filed as an exhibit to a report on Form 8-K (§ 249.308) which is incorporated by reference into a registration statement subsequent to its effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan of acquisition, reorganization, arrangement, liquidation, or succession
rubrics_metrics.description: Any material plan of acquisition, disposition, reorganization, readjustment, succession, liquidation, or arrangement and any amendments thereto described in the statement or report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrant may redact specific provisions/terms of exhibits required by paragraph (b)(2) if the information is customarily treated as private/confidential and not material. Must mark exhibit index to indicate omissions, include prominent statement on first page of redacted exhibit identifying excluded information and that it is not material and is treated as private/confidential, and include brackets where information is omitted. If requested, registrant must promptly provide unredacted copy and materiality/privacy analyses; Commission may require amendment to include previously redacted information. Registrant may request confidential treatment of supplemental material under § 200.83 while in Commission possession; after review, Commission/staff will return or destroy it if registrant complies with § 230.418 or 240.12b-4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles of incorporation
rubrics_metrics.description: The articles of incorporation of the registrant or instruments corresponding thereto as currently in effect and any amendments thereto.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When registrant files an amendment to its articles, it must file a complete copy of the articles as amended. If the amendment is reported on Form 8-K (§ 249.308), only the text of the amendment is required as a Form 8-K exhibit, and a complete copy of the amended articles must be filed as an exhibit to the next Securities Act registration statement or periodic report to which this exhibit requirement applies. If impracticable to file charter amendment with state prior to effectiveness, registrant may file form of amendment as an exhibit; if material changes are made after filing, the registrant must file the changed copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bylaws
rubrics_metrics.description: The bylaws of the registrant or instruments corresponding thereto as currently in effect and any amendments thereto.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whenever an amendment to bylaws is filed, file a complete copy of the amended bylaws. If amendment is reported on Form 8-K (§ 249.308), registrant need only file the text of the amendment as a Form 8-K exhibit; complete bylaws as amended must be filed as an exhibit to the next applicable Securities Act registration statement or periodic report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruments defining rights of security holders (including indentures)
rubrics_metrics.description: All instruments defining the rights of holders of the equity or debt securities being registered including, where applicable, the relevant portion of the articles of incorporation or by-laws.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exceptions: (iii) there need not be filed any instrument with respect to long-term debt not being registered if total securities authorized thereunder does not exceed 10% of total assets and an agreement to furnish copy upon request is filed; any instrument with respect to any class of securities if appropriate steps assure redemption/retirement prior to or upon delivery; copies of instruments evidencing scrip certificates for fractions of shares. If securities are issued under an indenture to be qualified under the Trust Indenture Act, the filed copy must include or be accompanied by (A) a reasonably itemized and informative table of contents and (B) a cross-reference sheet showing location of provisions inserted pursuant to sections 310-318(a) of the Trust Indenture Act. For Forms 8-K and 10-Q that disclose creation of new class or modification of rights in the text of Form 10-Q, file all instruments defining the rights of holders of these securities or indebtedness, subject to the exclusion re long-term debt not being registered in paragraph (b)(4)(iii)(A). Instruction 1: need not file any instrument which defines rights of participants (not as security holders) pursuant to an employee benefit plan. Instruction 2 (electronic filings): if instrument is in the form of a certificate, reproduce text appearing on the certificate in an electronic filing together with description of any other graphic/image material per Rule 304 of Regulation S-T (§ 232.304).

rubrics_metrics.name: Opinion re legality
rubrics_metrics.description: An opinion of counsel as to the legality of the securities being registered, indicating whether they will, when sold, be legally issued, fully paid and non-assessable, and, if debt securities, whether they will be binding obligations of the registrant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If securities are issued under a plan subject to ERISA, furnish either (A) an opinion of counsel confirming plan provisions comply with ERISA requirements pertaining to such provisions, or (B) a copy of IRS determination letter that the plan is qualified under section 401. If plan has been amended subsequent to prior filing, furnish either (A) opinion of counsel confirming amended provisions comply with ERISA, or (B) copy of IRS determination letter for amended plan. Note: see Item 8 of Form S-8 for exemptions applicable to that Form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence regarding non-reliance on prior audit report
rubrics_metrics.description: Any written notice from the registrant's current or previously engaged independent accountant that the independent accountant is withdrawing a previously issued audit report or that a previously issued audit report or completed interim review should no longer be relied upon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also includes any letter, pursuant to Item 4.02(c) of Form 8-K (§ 249.308), from the independent accountant to the Commission stating whether the independent accountant agrees with the registrant's statements describing the events giving rise to the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opinion re tax matters
rubrics_metrics.description: For Form S-11 filings or those to which Securities Act Industry Guide 5 applies, an opinion of counsel or of an independent public or certified public accountant or, in lieu thereof, an IRS revenue ruling, supporting the tax matters and consequences to shareholders as described in the filing when such tax matters are material to the transaction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Otherwise, this exhibit need only be filed where tax consequences are material to an investor and a representation as to tax consequences is set forth in the filing. If tax opinion is set forth in full in the filing, an indication may be made in lieu of filing the exhibit. Tax opinions may be conditioned or qualified provided conditions and qualifications are adequately described in the filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voting trust agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Any voting trust agreements and amendments thereto.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Every contract not made in the ordinary course of business that is material to the registrant and is to be performed in whole or in part at or after the filing of the registration statement or report; and for newly reporting registrants, every such contract entered into not more than two years before the relevant filing or transaction date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only contracts to which the registrant or a subsidiary is a party or has succeeded to by assumption/assignment or in which registrant/subsidiary has a beneficial interest need be filed. Contracts ordinarily accompanying the business are deemed in the ordinary course and need not be filed unless they fall into categories (ii)(A)-(D): (A) contracts to which directors, officers, promoters, named security holders, or underwriters are parties (other than ordinary purchase/sale of current assets at market price); (B) contracts upon which registrant's business is substantially dependent (e.g., continuing contracts to sell or purchase major part of products/services or franchise/license agreements critical to business); (C) any contract calling for acquisition/sale of property/plant/equipment exceeding 15% of fixed assets on consolidated basis; (D) any material lease under which part of property described in registration statement/report is held by the registrant. Management contracts and compensatory plans: (iii)(A)-(B) require filing of plans/contracts in which directors or named executive officers participate and other management contracts/compensatory plans unless immaterial; (iii)(C) lists categories of management/compensatory agreements that need not be filed (ordinary purchase/sales agency agreements; agreements with managers of stores; contracts providing for bonuses/payments to a class of security holders; plans available to employees generally with same allocation method; compensatory plans of foreign private issuers if disclosure not required in home country and not publicly disclosed; plans of wholly owned subsidiaries of companies with registered class of securities under certain circumstances). Registrant may redact specific provisions/terms of exhibits required by paragraph (b)(10) if customarily treated as private/confidential and not material; must mark exhibit index, include prominent statement on first page of redacted exhibit, include brackets where omitted, and if requested provide unredacted copy and analyses; Commission may require amendment to include previously redacted information; registrant may request confidential treatment of supplemental material under § 200.83 while in Commission possession; after review Commission/staff will return or destroy it if registrant complies with § 230.418 or 240.12b-4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruction defining 'newly reporting registrant'
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of 'newly reporting registrant' for purposes of paragraph (b)(10)(i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: 1) any registrant filing a registration statement that is not subject to reporting requirements of Section 13(a) or 15(d) at time of filing (whether or not previously subject); 2) any registrant that has not filed an annual report since revival of suspended reporting obligation; 3) any registrant that (a) was a shell company (other than a business combination related shell company) immediately before completing a transaction causing it to cease being a shell company and (b) has not filed a registration statement or Form 8-K as required by Items 2.01 and 5.06 since such transaction. Example: includes registrant filing its first registration statement under the Securities Act or Exchange Act, and a registrant that was a public shell company and completes a reverse merger causing it to cease being a shell company.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruction on filing compensatory plans and timing of contract exhibits
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions concerning which compensatory documents must be filed and when contracts executed/becoming effective during reporting period must be filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction 2 to paragraph (b)(10): Except for management contracts, registrants need only file copies of various compensatory plans and need not file each individual's personal agreement under the plans unless particular provisions in such personal agreements are necessary to investor's understanding of that individual's compensation. Instruction 3 to paragraph (b)(10): If a material contract is executed or becomes effective during the reporting period reflected by a Form 10-Q or Form 10-K, it must be filed as an exhibit to the Form 10-Q or Form 10-K filed for the corresponding period. For quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, only contracts executed or becoming effective during the most recent period reflected in the report must be filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual or quarterly report to security holders
rubrics_metrics.description: The registrant's annual report to security holders for its last fiscal year or its quarterly report to security holders, if all or a portion thereof is incorporated by reference in the filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such report, except for portions expressly incorporated by reference, is furnished for information of the Commission and is not to be deemed 'filed' as part of the filing. If financial statements in the report have been incorporated by reference, the accountant's certificate must be manually signed in one copy. See Rule 439 (§ 230.439). Electronic filings: if all or any portion of the annual/quarterly report to security holders is incorporated by reference into any electronic filing, that portion must be filed in electronic format as an exhibit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: Any code of ethics, or amendment thereto, that is the subject of disclosure required by § 229.406 (Item 406 of Regulation S-K) or Item 5.05 of Form 8-K, to the extent registrant intends to satisfy Item 406 or Item 5.05 requirements through filing of an exhibit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letter re unaudited interim financial information
rubrics_metrics.description: A letter from the independent accountant acknowledging awareness of the use in a registration statement of a report on unaudited interim financial information that pursuant to Rule 436(c) is not considered part of a registration statement prepared or certified by an accountant within meaning of sections 7 and 11 of the Securities Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such letter may be filed with the registration statement, an amendment thereto, or a report on Form 10-Q which is incorporated by reference into the registration statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letter re change in certifying accountant
rubrics_metrics.description: A letter from the registrant's former independent accountant regarding its concurrence or disagreement with the statements made by the registrant in the current report concerning the resignation or dismissal as the registrant's principal accountant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence on departure of director
rubrics_metrics.description: Any written correspondence from a former director concerning the circumstances surrounding the former director's retirement, resignation, refusal to stand for re-election or removal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes any letter from the former director to the registrant stating whether the former director agrees with statements made by the registrant describing the former director's departure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letter re change in accounting principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless previously filed, a letter from the registrant's independent accountant indicating whether any change in accounting principles or practices (or in method of applying them) that affected the financial statements being filed or is reasonably certain to affect future fiscal years is to an alternative principle which in his judgment is preferable under the circumstances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No such letter need be filed when change is made in response to a standard adopted by the Financial Accounting Standards Board that creates a new accounting principle, expresses a preference for an accounting principle, or rejects a specific accounting principle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insider trading policies and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Any insider trading policies and procedures, or amendments thereto, that are the subject of disclosure required by § 229.408(b) (Item 408(b) of Regulation S-K).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other documents or statements to security holders
rubrics_metrics.description: If the registrant makes available to its stockholders or otherwise publishes, within the period prescribed for filing the report, a document or statement containing information meeting some or all of the requirements of this form, the information called for may be incorporated by reference to such published document or statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided copies thereof are filed as an exhibit to the report on this form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subsidiaries of the registrant
rubrics_metrics.description: List all subsidiaries of the registrant, the state or other jurisdiction of incorporation or organization of each, and the names under which such subsidiaries do business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This list may be incorporated by reference from a document which includes a complete and accurate list. Names of particular subsidiaries may be omitted if the unnamed subsidiaries, considered in the aggregate as a single subsidiary, would not constitute a significant subsidiary as of the end of the year covered by this report (see definition of 'significant subsidiary' in Rule 1-02(w) of Regulation S-X). Names of consolidated wholly-owned multiple subsidiaries carrying on the same line of business may be omitted provided the name of the immediate parent, the line of business, number of omitted subsidiaries operating in the U.S. and number operating in foreign countries are given. Instruction does not apply to banks, insurance companies, savings and loan associations or to any subsidiary subject to regulation by another Federal agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subsidiary guarantors, issuers of guaranteed securities, and affiliates whose securities collateralize registrant securities
rubrics_metrics.description: List each entity that is a guarantor, issuer, or co-issuer of the guaranteed security subject to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act or the offer/sale being registered, and each affiliate whose security is pledged as collateral for the registrant's security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For parent company registrants subject to § 210.13-01, list each subsidiary that is a guarantor/issuer/co-issuer. For registrants subject to § 210.13-02, list each affiliate whose security is pledged as collateral and identify the security(ies) pledged. An entity need not be listed more than once so long as its role with respect to each applicable security is clearly indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consents of experts and counsel
rubrics_metrics.description: All written consents required to be filed shall be dated and manually signed; where the consent of an expert or counsel is contained in his report or opinion or elsewhere in the registration statement or document filed therewith, a reference shall be made in the index to the report, part of the registration statement or document, or opinion containing the consent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Exchange Act reports: where filing of a written consent is required with respect to material incorporated by reference in a previously filed Securities Act registration statement, such consent may be filed as an exhibit to the material incorporated by reference. Such consents must be dated and manually signed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of attorney
rubrics_metrics.description: If any name is signed to the registration statement or report pursuant to a power of attorney, manually signed copies of such power of attorney shall be filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where the power of attorney is contained elsewhere in the registration statement/documents filed therewith a reference shall be made in the index to the part containing such power. If any officer signs pursuant to a power of attorney, certified copies of a board resolution authorizing such signature shall also be filed. A power of attorney filed with the Commission shall relate to a specific filing or amendment; however, a power of attorney relating to a registration statement under the Securities Act or an amendment thereto may also relate to any registration statement for the same offering that is to be effective upon filing pursuant to Rule 462(b). A power of attorney that confers general authority shall not be filed with the Commission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of eligibility of trustee
rubrics_metrics.description: A statement of eligibility and qualification of each person designated to act as trustee under an indenture to be qualified under the Trust Indenture Act of 1939.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such statement of eligibility shall be bound separately from other exhibits. Electronic filings: the requirement to bind separately does not apply to electronic submissions; such statements must be submitted as exhibits in the same electronic submission as the registration statement or in an amendment, except electronic filers that rely on Trust Indenture Act Section 305(b)(2) shall file such statements separately in the manner prescribed by § 260.5b-1 through § 260.5b-3 and by the EDGAR Filer Manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rule 13a-14(a)/15d-14(a) Certifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Certifications required by Rule 13a-14(a) or Rule 15d-14(a) exactly as set forth in the rule: a named certifying individual certifies review of the report, absence of material misstatements/omissions, fair presentation of financial statements, responsibilities for disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting and evaluation thereof, disclosure of changes in internal control, and disclosure to auditors/audit committee of significant deficiencies/material weaknesses and fraud involving management or employees with significant roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a separate certification for each principal executive officer and principal financial officer of the registrant. Certification must include specified numbered paragraphs (1)-(5) and subparagraphs (a)-(d) in paragraph 4 and (a)-(b) in paragraph 5. Include date, signature, and title. See Rules 13a-14(a) and 15d-14(a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rule 13a-14(d)/15d-14(d) Certifications for asset-backed issuers
rubrics_metrics.description: Certifications required by Rule 13a-14(d) or Rule 15d-14(d) for asset-backed issuers: certify review of Form 10-K and all required Form 10-D reports, that Exchange Act periodic reports taken as a whole are not misleading, all distribution/servicing/other information required to be provided under Form 10-D is included, servicers have fulfilled obligations in all material respects (as applicable), reports on compliance with servicing criteria and attestation reports are included as exhibits, and reasonable reliance on information provided by unaffiliated parties (as applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For asset-backed issuers, certification must be signed by either (1) the senior officer in charge of securitization of the depositor if the depositor signs the Form 10-K; or (2) the senior officer in charge of the servicing function of the servicer if the servicer signs the Form 10-K on behalf of the issuing entity. If multiple servicers are involved, the senior officer in charge of the servicing function of the master servicer must sign if a representative of the servicer is to sign. A natural person must sign the certification in his/her individual capacity, although title may be included under the signature. The first version of paragraph 4 is to be used when the servicer is signing on behalf of the issuing entity. Include date, signature, and title.
